title: Fractured
abstract:
Description
This short film Fractured was a project for my Docufiction class in which we were tasked to make a personal film. For my personal film I chose to document my struggle with trying to remember the events after a car accident I was involved in. With the amnesia I experienced, I trace back my footsteps trying to fill the blanks. I express what it feels like to live with no memory of the incident and how it affects me mentally and physically to this day.

Artist statement 
Fractured showcases the struggle I face coping with the lack of memory and the physical and mental changes I experience after a life altering car accident. Almost 10 years on, I still try to piece together what happened from fragmented memories, some of which are fact and some fiction. Fractured aims to try and make the audience evoke the same feelings I have surrounding this traumatic incident. I do this by the lack of music, monochromatic theme and softly spoken words.
